mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns following FEDFUNDS < 2.0% are negative, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE below 5.5%) combined with strong residential sales (RSAFS above 380,000 million) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.5% and RSAFS > 380000, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by strong GDP growth and low unemployment), a CPIAUCSL reading above 2.0% signals inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in that regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day SPX returns following INDPRO levels above 110 are negative, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces consumer confidence and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day SPX returns following FEDFUNDS < 2.0% are negative, or Rank IC over any 5-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
